anywhere                                                                           review
  ?                     this screen, except while a message is half typed            j / k                 move
  ctrl+c                quit, asked twice in a conversation                          enter                 open the changes, then a file
                                                                                     tab                   cycle the queue, ranking, cost outcome and overlap
chat                                                                                 c                     commit, from the file list
  enter                 send                                                         K                     credentials
  shift+tab             plan or build, which is what the agent may change            esc                   back one level
  /                     the command list, which narrows as you type
  up / down             move the command list, or otherwise your sent history      a diff
  tab                   take the highlighted command                                 j / k                 scroll a line
  //                    send a literal prompt beginning with slash                   space                 scroll a page
  esc                   interrupt the turn, or clear a half written message          g / G                 top and end
  ctrl+c                stop the turn, then twice to quit                            esc                   back to the file list
  ctrl+n                a new conversation, keeping this one
  ctrl+d                agents, and it works with a question waiting here          writing a commit
  ctrl+k                credentials                                                  ctrl+s                commit. nothing is staged until then
  ctrl+r                compact the conversation, asked twice because it spends      esc                   cancel, throwing the message away
  ctrl+o                show tool output and diffs in full, and fold them back
  pgup / pgdown         scroll the conversation, or the btw panel while it is up   worktrees
  mouse drag            select conversation text, copied when you let go             j / k                 move
  ctrl+home / ctrl+end  the top, and back to following                               g / G                 top and end, as do home and end
  alt+enter             a line break instead of sending                              r                     refresh
  enter / y             allow a tool call once, while a question is up               K                     credentials
  a                     allow it for the rest of the session                         esc / tab / q         agents
  arrows / pgup         read on with a question up, deciding nothing
  any other key         refuse it                                                  the model picker, on /model
                                                                                     j / k                 move, across credentials as well as within one
another agent's question, above the box                                              enter                 run this conversation on it from the next message
  enter                 approve it once, while the box is empty                      ctrl+k                credentials, to change what a key defaults to
  backspace             decline it, while the box is empty                           any other key         back, with nothing changed
  ctrl+g                open its conversation and full request
  a                     always is answered on that full prompt only                credentials

agents                                                                               enter                 use this one for the conversation
  1 to 8                jump to that pane, and again to open it                      m                     set which model it talks to
  enter                 open the selected agent, or approve its question once        e                     rename it. the value is not asked for again
  backspace             decline the selected agent's question                        a / n                 add one
  h / j / k / l         move around the grid, as do the arrows                       d / x                 remove one
  v                     cycle list, mosaic, hero and focus                           r                     reload the list
  [ / ]                 page, when there are more agents than panes                  esc / tab             back to where you were
  tab                   next agent, or into the mosaic from the list                 q                     quit
  n                     new agent
  y                     create it, on the direct mode confirmation
  w                     worktree monitor
